title: Rabble
lines: A little company when you want it.
Drop into a soft, living pile of AI clay characters.
Share something small, hear a reply, or just settle in.
say: This is Rabble. A little company when you want it. You drop into a soft, living pile of A I clay characters, share something small, hear a reply, or just settle in.

title: Every person: Muse Image
lines: 47 characters, ages 10 to 90.
Up to seven poses each: awake, reaching, dozing.
SAM 3.1 cut every figure out of its background.
Muse Spark checked every picture for extra arms.
say: Every person here was drawn by Meta's Muse Image. Forty seven characters, ages ten to ninety, in up to seven poses each. SAM three point one cut every figure out, and Muse Spark checked every picture for extra arms.

title: Become a Rabble you
lines: 1. SAM 3.1 cuts you out of your photo.
2. Muse Image redraws you in soft clay.
3. SAM 3.1 cuts the new you out again.
Your photo is never saved.
say: Your photo becomes a Rabble you. SAM cuts you out of the photo, Muse Image redraws you in soft clay, and SAM cuts the new you out again. The photo itself is never saved.

title: The pile catches you
lines: You fall in, and the people make room.
Someone beside you says: "There you are."
Your light says "You" for a moment.
say: Join, and you fall into the pile. The people beside you make room. There you are, someone says, and your little light shows where you landed.

title: What's on your mind?
lines: Someone beside you asks.
Answer: the box opens right next to you.
Or choose "Just sitting": the pile dozes
around you and leaves you in peace.
say: Then someone beside you asks, what's on your mind? You can answer, right there in the pile. Or choose just sitting, and the people around you doze off and leave you in peace.

title: Your words stay yours: Muse Spark
lines: What you share goes up exactly as you wrote it.
Muse Spark first checks it's kind, PG and anonymous.
Then a clay person answers you warmly,
remembering what you said earlier.
say: What you share goes up exactly as you wrote it. Muse Spark first checks that it's kind and anonymous. Then a clay person beside you answers warmly, remembering what you said before.

title: The pile answers with its bodies
lines: With each answer, Muse Spark picks a gesture:
a cheer for a small win, a lean on a hard day,
a ripple of laughs, or a quiet doze.
A squeeze travels from them to you.
say: And the pile answers with its bodies. With each reply, Muse Spark picks a gesture. A small win gets a cheer. A long week gets people leaning in, and a hush. A little squeeze travels from them to you.

title: Widen the ring
lines: Neighborhood, city, state, world.
Everyone falls in, and the tower grows.
Clouds, birds, and now and then an eagle overhead.
say: Widen the ring from your neighborhood to the whole world, and everyone falls in. Clouds drift overhead, a few birds, and now and then, an eagle.

title: Made with care
lines: Each visit is private to you.
The Meta key stays on the server, never in the page.
Limits per visitor and per day keep it safe and affordable.
No account. No profile. No feed.
say: It's built with care. Each visit is private. The Meta key stays on the server. Limits keep it safe and affordable. And there's no account, no profile, and no feed.

title: Rabble
lines: Rabble turns a small conversation
into a place you can feel part of.
unim3dia.github.io/rabble
say: Rabble turns a small conversation into a place you can feel part of. Made with Meta's Muse Image, SAM three point one, and Muse Spark. Come find your spot.
